_doc: Initial sweep spec for the Dell-XPS 24/7 GPU loop. Seeds the queue with
the two specimens we have cached locally (the IMPC mouse embryo and the
Felis catus fixture) across a small grid of floor-frac + density combos.
Goal: characterize how sensitive bright-seed saturation is to those two
knobs on a wide-tail soft-tissue volume (mouse) vs a moderate-tail HU CT
(Felis). Each combination runs autopilot-derived params with the listed
knob explicitly overridden, so the run uses the volume-derived defaults
